only_training_change: Increase maximum epochs from 30 to 150; keep patience=5 and min_delta=0.0001
selection: Jan-Mar fitting / April validation normalized prediction MSE; refit Jan-Apr at selected epoch count
calibration: Re-estimate LSTM residual scales and 0.995 quantile on the same May-Jun points; identical calibration procedure, not identical numeric thresholds
evaluation: Exactly the previous 422 scenes and July-Aug empirical replay; preserve all three seeds
stop_rule: Run this fixed budget once; no epoch/seed/threshold selection using development warning outcomes
